name: @mtdss/previewer
description: MTDSS 免下载预览渲染包(零 React;pdf/text/md 渲染;桌面静态 import + 移动 WebView 资产同源)

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cand=['node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm','../node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm'].find(p=>fs.existsSync(p));if(!cand){console.error('wasm src not found');process.exit(1)}const dst='dist/wasm';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(cand)){if(f.endsWith('.wasm')||f.endsWith('.js'))fs.copyFileSync(cand+'/'+f,dst+'/'+f)}console.log('wasm assets copied')"
